answer: The kernel counter is kept in voyage and haven shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4866 identities would post 2391 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
